lesson.guided_practice:
PRACTISE BEFORE READING THE FEEDBACK
Name two skills: change from $20 for $13.45; unit price of 4 for $10.

FEEDBACK
Subtraction/change; unit pricing.

WATCH FOR
Skipping unit prices on “best buy” review items hides false choices.

Complete a twenty-four-item money review. Tally errors by skill and set one practice goal.

Write a short reflection naming one step you corrected and why.

lesson.parent_notes:
Parent: Marking guidance for the independent task: Complete a twenty-four-item money review. Tally errors by skill and set one practice goal. Accept equivalent original responses that show the same skill.

Parent: Written model 1: Sample: new numbers solved with visible working for review; key places/values named. Do not award marks for retyping the model.

Parent: Written model 2: Sample misconception: Skipping unit prices on “best buy” review items hides false choices.. Correction uses Subtraction/change; unit pricing.. Why: restores accurate review.

Parent: Likely misconception: Skipping unit prices on “best buy” review items hides false choices. Keep sample answers out of the child role.

Parent: Short-answer focus 1: Solve one fresh problem that uses review with different numbers from the worked model. Show working and name the places or values that matter.

Parent: Short-answer focus 2: Describe one likely mistake with review, show corrected working, and say why the correction works.

Parent: Marking notes: Accept any mathematically valid solution that uses new numbers, shows working for review, and names places/values. Reject copied model numbers. / Accept a named misconception about review, corrected working, and a method reason. Reject vague “I was wrong” with no repair..

teach_steps.example:
WORKED MODEL
Review path: add money → change → unit price → budget total → word problem check.

TRY FIRST
Name two skills: change from $20 for $13.45; unit price of 4 for $10.

FEEDBACK

teach_steps.explain:
Unit review mixes money ±, change, unit prices, budgets and multi-step money stories with sense checks.

WHY IT MATTERS
This helps the learner choose methods based on place value, quantity and accurate working, rather than guessing digits by shape alone. Keep every step justified.

HOW TO WORK
Read the worked example and name the places, values or distances that carry the method. Before looking at the correction, make your own attempt using the exact question provided. Compare your working with the feedback: did you use the same skill and show your reasoning? If a digit or place is uncertain, identify what would have to be regrouped or counted again. One deliberate, justified revision is more useful than writing a longer answer.
teach_steps.notice: Skipping unit prices on “best buy” review items hides false choices. Correct the value or method, not just the appearance of the digits.
